summary.text: Eric Gjerde is a Democratic state representative for Iowa House District 74 and has served in the Iowa House since 2021.

paragraphs.text: The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Gjerde as a Cedar Rapids police officer, born in 1978 in Spicer, Minnesota, with degrees from Augustana College, the University of Iowa and the University of Northern Iowa (Ed.D.).
According to Gjerde's campaign website, Gjerde taught special education and math for 14 years at Thomas Jefferson High School in Cedar Rapids and earlier taught at Clear Creek Amana High School.
